name: web-lavender-story-scroll-with-blurred-word-chips-and-panoramic-ad-screen
title: Lavender Story Scroll with Blurred Word Chips
whatItIs: A tall pale lavender page with a winding dashed path connecting italic headline statements ('Helping Seniors Living Independently', 'With or Without Memory Challenges'), blurred word chips at the sides (Overwhelming, Anxious), tilted photo cards, a panoramic display showing a joyful grandparent and child beside a phone ad, and a Location Tracker node at the base.
whatItMeans: A dotted path and blurred chips create a soft narrative journey, and warm photography brings human emotion to a pale page.
techniques: Blurred out-of-focus word chips for depth
Tilted photo cards floating in white space
Panoramic screen as a mid-page feature

vocabulary.definition: A defocused pill of text used as background texture.
A line that leads the eye through a story.
A wide display showing multiple pieces of content.
